thought: This is a setting-focused prompt for the Persimmon Woods that serves as the 7th Company's temporary bivouac area. The distinctive feature is the persimmon tree grove with its characteristic fruits and foliage. Emphasis on nighttime with dappled, mottled lighting creating a temporarily relaxed atmosphere - a brief respite from combat. The lighting should come from campfires or moonlight filtering through the canopy, creating the 斑驳 (mottled/dappled) effect mentioned.
prompt: Wide environmental shot of a persimmon tree grove serving as temporary military bivouac area for Eighth Route Army forces, nighttime autumn 1941. Eye-level view capturing the distinctive persimmon orchard with gnarled trees bearing ripening orange-red fruits among darkened foliage. Asymmetrical naturalistic composition with persimmon tree trunks creating vertical elements throughout the frame, branches forming organic canopy overhead. Foreground showing packed earth clearing with simple military bivouac elements - bedrolls, basic camping equipment, stacked rifles leaning against tree trunks, mess kits. Middle ground featuring multiple persimmon trees with characteristic twisted branches and clustered fruit silhouettes, sparse autumn leaves. Background revealing deeper grove layers fading into darkness. Dramatic mottled nighttime lighting with warm campfire glow casting dancing amber light and flickering shadows across tree bark and ground, interplaying with cool silvery moonlight filtering through gaps in the canopy creating dappled light patterns (斑驳光线). Strong chiaroscuro with pools of warm firelight contrasting against deep blue-black shadows between trees. Desaturated earth-tone color palette with muted persimmon orange punctuating the scene, warm ochre firelight, cool night grays, deep shadow browns, and darkened olive foliage tones. Temporarily relaxed, contemplative atmosphere with undertones of watchful military readiness - a brief peaceful moment amid wartime. Realistic heavily-painted 2D animation style with thick impasto brushwork on tree bark textures, visible paint strokes creating light-play effects, pronounced tonal contrast. Moderate depth of field keeping foreground bivouac area and nearby trees sharp while deeper grove softens into atmospheric darkness. Environmental documentary portraiture with cinematic low-key nighttime aesthetic. Warm-to-cool color temperature interplay between firelight and moonlight. Moody, intimate atmosphere emphasizing the transient sanctuary of this temporary encampment.
